name: Ses Finques Ibiza — property management
when: Year-round · for owners who aren't here all winter
desc: Mayte looks after houses whose owners live elsewhere: regular inspections, maintenance coordination, garden and pool care, the house ready and warm before you land, plus the paperwork — bills, invoices, payments — and rental management if you let it out. The person you call when the gardener says there's water where there shouldn't be.

name: 24nannies — event, hotel & villa nannies
when: On request · a night, a week or a whole stay
desc: A Dutch agency with twelve years of placing nannies with families, villas, hotels and events, on the island as well as at home: a sitter for Saturday night, a nanny for the week the grandparents visit, childcare at a wedding or a company dinner so the grown-ups can stay at the table. Nannies are reference-checked, hold a certificate of conduct and have child first aid. Ask for a quote with your dates.
status: Books for Ibiza all year — ask early for Christmas and New Year

name: Tante Will — your Dutch babysitter on Ibiza
when: On request · evenings, days, holiday weeks
desc: One person, not an agency: an experienced Dutch babysitter who lives on the island, with a background in social pedagogy, for the evening you want to go out, the days the kids are off school and the week family stays over. Speaks Dutch and English with the little ones. Message her on Instagram or through her site with your dates.

name: Homegirlz — extra hands for home, boat or event
type: Home help · groceries · event & boat crew
when: On request · by the hour or the day
desc: "Here to help you with whatever life brings" — and on this island that means: the fridge filled before you land, the house turned around between guests, two more pairs of hands on the boat or behind the bar at your party, the errand you can't fit in. New this winter, so the fastest way in is a DM with what you need and when.
